title: achillea oxyloba subsp. schurii
intro: Achillea oxyloba subsp. schurii, commonly known as yarrow, is a perennial plant species in the sunflower family, known for its fern-like foliage and white or yellow flowers. The health benefits of yarrow include its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which can help to reduce pain, swelling, and the risk of infection. The therapeutic actions of yarrow include its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce menstrual cramps, and alleviate symptoms of colds and flu, making it a popular natural remedy in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of yarrow include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
